name: Derealization.
source:
You play as an almost thirty-year-old "young" man, who is fleeing from mental discomfort, leaves his hometown and moves to Steelport, the largest city in the state. Hoping to find peace with his own mind there. But he is too far from a state of harmony because every day there are more and more problems related to his new and old friends. Every day he becomes more and more convinced of the inadequacy of the people around him, who literally broke the chain.

But...

What if the problem is not in them?

[From [url=https://greenish-purple.itch.io/derealization]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演一个近三十岁的“年轻人”，他为了逃避精神上的不适，离开家乡，搬到了该州最大的城市斯蒂尔波特。希望在那里找到内心的平静。但他距离和谐的状态还很远，因为每天都有越来越多的问题与他的新老朋友有关。每一天，他都越来越相信他周围的人的不足，他们确实打破了链条。

但是…

如果问题不在他们身上怎么办？

[来自[url=https://greenish-purple.itch.io/derealization]Itch.io[/url]]
